programs.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.sub_title: Explore some of the interesting and bizarre revenge stories, including the one about a Colorado man who used a killdozer to settle a dispute and an emperor's vengeance towards his wife's lover
programs.desc: Host Dan Aykroyd uncovers some of the most mysterious and bizarre inventions, creatures, people and things throughout history, by using dynamic visuals, archival images, and expert interviews.

actor: Dan Aykroyd,Adam Richman,Hakeem Oluseyi,Mitch Horowitz,Don Wildman,Martin K.A. Morgan

programs.title: Life After People
programs.sub_title: After humans disappear from the planet, the oceans and rivers flood the cities and dams left behind, causing them to be destroyed
programs.desc: On the heels of the History channel special that explored what Earth might be like if the human race were suddenly to disappear comes a series that provides, in even-more detail, a picture of a post-human future, revealing the fate of structures like the Sears Tower and the Sistine Chapel and creatures that might inherit the places we once lived. Supporting the visuals and special effects are interviews with specialists from the fields of engineering, botany, biology, geology and archaeology.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.sub_title: Mike and Frank visit a gorgeous Kentucky property with a racetrack. Later, a freestyle stop in North Carolina looks like a bust until they unearth a one-of-a-kind TV relic
programs.desc: Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz are Midwestern pickers that travel across America in search of rare artefacts and national treasures that they can buy from the collectors they visit and then sell in their antiques shops or, in some cases, put in their personal collections; they usually have to dig through boxes or piles filled with items that have accumulated over the years, which are often located in such places as barns or spare rooms in the owners' homes; while the guys are willing to buy pretty much anything old, their particular interests include items having to do with the auto industry and classic toys.

programs.title: Shipping Wars
programs.sub_title: Jessica signs up to move a half-ton steampunk robot in a single day. Meanwhile, Todd and Tamera realise that moonshine stills and porcelain plates don't mix well
programs.desc: You won't hear the phrase \"free shipping\" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

actor: Marc Springer,Jennifer Brennan,Jarrett Joyce,Christopher Hanna,Robbie Welsh,Dusty Davie,Todd Sturgis,Tamera Sturgis,Jessica Samko

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.sub_title: Rick Harrison and his family own and run a pawn shop in Las Vegas. They purchase, sell and evaluate interesting artefacts with fascinating stories
programs.desc: This series opens the doors to the only family-run pawnshop in Las Vegas, where three generations of the Harrison family use their sharp-eyed skills to assess what's real and what's fake. Objects the colorful customers bring in range from the obscure to the truly historic, and it's up to the guys at the Gold \u0026 Silver Pawn Shop -- with help at times from their network of experts -- to reveal the sometimes surprising answer to \"What's this worth?\".

actor: Corey Harrison,Rick Harrison,Austin Chumlee Russell,Richard Harrison

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: A group of experts tries to restore American vintage items to their original state while facing a number of challenges during the job.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.sub_title: Ryan works on a secret project for Bones Legacy. Meanwhile, a Chevy Impala redefines the term low-rider, stunning Mike and Roli. Later, Danny checks out a Satellite Sebring but cannot crack a deal
programs.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the \"Pawn Stars\" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny \"The Count\" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. From classic cars like Thunderbirds and Corvettes to sidecar motorcycles and everything in between, if it has wheels, the Count's Kustoms team can make it look spectacular.

programs.title: The Food That Built America
programs.sub_title: Will Kellogg's ultimate reign is thrown into chaos after the arrival of a young flour mill executive whose product gives birth to a decades-long war for dominance between Kellogg's and General Mills
programs.desc: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the history of American food culture, tracing the origin and development of famous dishes.

programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.sub_title: The filmmaker sheds light on the existence of serpent Gods in the religious traditions of several places in the Asian and South American regions
programs.desc: Investigators circle the globe in search of evidence in their quest to determine whether life on Earth began in outer space and if aliens influenced mankind in ancient times. Did extraterrestrial beings visit Earth and share information about technology and influence human religions? And more importantly, if aliens visited the planet before, will they return? Alien theorists believe that the answer to both questions is a resounding yes.

actor: Robert Clotworthy,Giorgio A. Tsoukalos,Erich von Däniken,David Childress,William Henry,Linda Moulton Howe,David Wilcock,Jonathan Young,Jason Martell

programs.title: Royal India with Samira
programs.sub_title: Udaipur's prince grants Samira exclusive access to the City Palace where his personal staff guide her to hidden terraces and breathtaking vistas
programs.desc: Renowned USA-based chef Samira Nanda explores the palaces of India in search of the culinary secrets of the nation's royal families.

programs.title: Omg! Yeh Mera India Classics
programs.desc: A compilation of the best episodes of 'OMG! Yeh Mera India', wherein the host sheds light on several inspiring and exciting stories from across India.

programs.title: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death
programs.sub_title: Competitors test the mettle of a hybrid Yatagan sabre, a two-handed Bowie knife and other bladed weapons. Later, a female bladesmith comes close to a first-time achievement
programs.desc: The country's most experienced martial artists, bladesmiths and knife experts stab, slice and chop their way through some of the most daunting obstacles they have ever seen. Competitors put their skills to the test as they slice through flying watermelons, hack through giant ice blocks, and slice various ropes, tubes, metals, and other objects. Blades that can be seen are America's historical Bowie knife, a Viking Seax, varying medieval swords, and traditional Japanese katanas. Each obstacle challenges the competitors to test the strength, durability and sharpness of their blades while also testing their own speed, precision and technique. The winner of each episode wins a cash prize and a coveted spot in the season finale. Once there, the winners have the chance to compete and win the title of Forged in Fire: Knife or Death Champion.
